name: Dungeons & Drumsticks
description: Routine meal preparation escalated into a fantasy campaign involving magical dice and heavily armed poultry.
observation: A perfectly reasonable response to being hungry.

name: The Fellowship of the Cart
description: A household grocery list was elevated to an interdepartmental quest of strategic procurement.
observation: One cart to rule them all.

name: The Watchtower
description: Unauthorized construction of a domestic monitoring facility to oversee machines that were previously minding their own business.
observation: The servers are being watched. Nobody knows why.
